item.title: Solved: How to Install Python 3 Packages via Pip on Ubuntu
item.description:
How to Install Python 3 Packages via Pip on Ubuntu

If you are using Ubuntu and have both Python 2.x and Python 3.x installed, you may encounter an issue where running pip install package-name defaults to installing the Python 2 version of the package. To effectively manage your Python environments and ensure you are installing packages for the correct version, follow the methods outlined below.
